rationale: Unusual lexeme appearing as cosmological designation of the Second Chariot of the First Man. Context (the σκηνή 'tabernacle' is established in him) requires a dwelling/abode/foundation sense. Possible underlying forms: ⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ ('honor'), a substantive of ⲭⲱ/ⲭⲏ ('be set, abide'), or possibly Greek τύχη. Pending parallel attestations.

Manichaean technical term: ⲧⲱϩⲙ 'to call, summon' substantivized. The cosmic Call (German Ruf), one half of the Call/Answer pair sent by the Living Spirit to the imprisoned First Man. Standard Manichaean cosmological vocabulary.
Manichaean technical term: ⲥⲱⲧⲙ 'to hear' substantivized = 'the Hearing/Answer' (German Antwort). Paired with ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ as the responding half of the cosmic Call/Answer dyad.

Compound ⲙⲁ-ⲛ-ⲧⲁⲗⲟ 'place of mounting' (from ⲧⲁⲗⲟ 'mount, ride'). Designates each of the four ranks of the Manichaean Church as a mounting-station upon the cosmic chariot. Preserves the chariot imagery that structures the entire kephalaion.
Lycopolitan reflex/contraction of ⲡⲓⲣⲉ/ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate.' Same root as ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' (already in glossary). Used here for the perfect Man's shining-forth in the Pillar of Glory.

Greek loanword ζώνη — the cosmic belt/zodiacal zone in which the ten chariots are mounted, paralleled by the additional four chariots that operate in the flesh. Standard astronomical-cosmological term.
